digest.component_or_area: CLI parser foundation and command help generation
propositions: Command syntax is fragmented across imperative argv loops, inline argparse, hand-maintained help files, and intercept descriptions, causing drift between parser, runtime help, and documentation.
Multiple parser definitions and help sources create risk of disagreement; a single argparse factory per command family eliminates duplication and enables deterministic, byte-stable help generation.

All command handlers must migrate from imperative parsing to pure, side-effect-free argparse factories while maintaining backward-compatible execution routing and preserving argv parity (accepted/rejected arguments, diagnostics, exit codes).

Generated help and package overview must be canonical, byte-deterministic, and served before operation/config/store/handler boundaries; retired or hidden commands must not appear or must remain undiscoverable per policy.
